page.title: Needs you
page.purpose: Show the operator the decisions that need an answer and the context needed to respond.

states.description: The first read is in flight; placeholder rows hold the place and are announced as loading.
Nothing is waiting: a checked all-clear with a link to past decisions.
Rows are shown while a refresh or a further page failed; the failure is said above the list and Retry keeps the rows.
The read failed: the cause is named with a retry, or the sign-in card when the owner session is missing.
Rows from an earlier read stay on screen while a refresh runs, and the footer says how long ago they were updated.
Urgency or sender filters are in force: they are chips under the sort menu, each removable in one tap, and the header says how many of the waiting decisions are shown.
The Filters sheet lists urgency and sender with how many decisions each would show; choosing one applies at once and the sheet stays open.
